description: Ministry of Highways & Road Development and Petroleum Resources Development - The National Thoroughfares (User Fee National Highway) Regulations. (Barawakumbuka - Mattala)
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by a minister under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It establishes legal requirements for user fees on specific national highways, including fee structures, collection procedures, and penalties for violations. While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim, it does not focus on his appointment or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the regulatory framework being established. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates binding legal requirements and enforcement mechanisms.
